description: This file defines the SystemCheck class, which performs various environment, database, permissions, and extension checks for the OrangeHRM system during installation or setup to ensure system compatibility and readiness.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: Performs environment checks, database compatibility, file permissions, and extension status verifications essential for system setup in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version falls within the allowed range specified in system requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Verifies compatibility of the MySQL client version.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks the MySQL server version and compatibility.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL InnoDB engine support is enabled.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Verifies if the current web server matches supported web servers.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks write permissions for the configuration directory.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks write permissions for the cache directory.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks write permissions for the log directory.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks write permissions for the cryptography keys directory.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Checks the maximum allowed PHP session idle time before timeout.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Verifies that the PHP register_globals setting is turned off.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Checks the memory allocated to PHP scripts and its compliance with thresholds.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the cURL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the SimpleXML extension is enabled.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the ZIP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the GD extension is enabled.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the Intl extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the PDO extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the PDO MySQL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the LDAP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the OpenSSL extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkWritePermission
methods.description: Attempts to write and delete a temporary file to verify directory write permissions.

methods.name: getSizeInBytes
methods.description: Converts a PHP memory size string (like '128M') to bytes.

methods.name: isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if a version string falls within a specified range and is not excluded.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on version constraints and exclusions.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a version is within an excluded range.

methods.name: getPhpVersion
methods.description: Returns the current PHP version.

methods.name: getWebServerDetails
methods.description: Returns the web server software details.

methods.name: getMysqlClientVersion
methods.description: Returns the MySQL client version.

methods.name: getMysqlServerVersion
methods.description: Returns the MySQL server version.

methods.name: getMySqlHostInfo
methods.description: Returns MySQL connection status information.

methods.name: getOSDetails
methods.description: Returns operating system details.

methods.name: getPDOConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection if available.

methods.name: getSystemDetails
methods.description: Returns a summary of system environment details.

methods.name: getSystemCheckResults
methods.description: Provides a structured overview of all system checks and their results.
